g.text: saved as you change them, shared with the desktop app
Reopen the last thread when the desktop app starts
When AFH starts again, it continues what it was doing
Show model, tokens and time under replies
Ctrl+J always adds a new line
Open the live panel while files are written
Needs a terminal at least 120 columns wide; Ctrl+B opens it anywhere
Ring the terminal bell when a run ends
The conversation follows whatever language you write in. The terminal app's own text is English;
Arabic and right-to-left are in the desktop app.
↑↓ move Enter change Tab sections Esc back
